description: Apply in Cloudflare dashboard for zone creativephotography.group (proxied / orange-cloud). Expressions use starts_with/ends_with only — no matches (regex) operator (requires Business or WAF Advanced).

rules.name: Bypass cache — auth, admin, API, non-GET
rules.expression: (http.host in {"creativephotography.group" "www.creativephotography.group"} and (http.request.method ne "GET" or http.cookie contains "sb-" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/account") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/login") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/signup") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/onboarding") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/forgot-password") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/reset-password") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/confirm/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cancel/")))

rules.name: Long edge cache — Next static chunks and public assets
rules.expression: (http.host in {"creativephotography.group" "www.creativephotography.group"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/icons/") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff2") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ico") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".svg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".png") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpeg")))
notes: ends_with covers public/ assets (e.g. /icons/*.svg). /_next/static/ covers hashed JS/CSS.
No regex — ends_with list is intentional for Free/Pro plans.

rules.name: Edge cache — public search API (optional)
rules.expression: (http.host in {"creativephotography.group" "www.creativephotography.group"} and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/search" and http.request.method eq "GET" and not http.cookie contains "sb-")
